title: The Blight We Were Born For

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A human soldier wearing an angel's halo around her neck, the right hand of Vorik and then Gideon, who takes command of the Zendikari remnant after surviving Kozilek's field.

entities.name: Vorik
entities.description: The previous commander-general of the Zendikari army who hired Tazri and named Gideon his successor as he died.

entities.name: Mahir
entities.description: A merchant who employed Tazri as captain of his caravan guard and later fired her.

entities.name: Romoe
entities.description: A young caravan guard who warns Tazri not to kill the angel and who is later turned inside out by Kozilek's wave.

entities.name: Magain
entities.description: A soldier who is aged backward to nothing by Kozilek's wave.

entities.name: Debins
entities.description: A soldier whose body is sheared in half by Kozilek's wave.

entities.name: Golamin
entities.description: A caravan guard sent to scout north.

entities.name: Rillem
entities.description: A caravan guard sent to scout south.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who led the Zendikari to trap Ulamog and is now missing, but appears in Tazri's vision being killed repeatedly by Kozilek.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A merfolk roilmage whose group is obliterated; he survives and is asked to open a rift against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: The vampire leader who rescues Noyan and, after Tazri's challenge, agrees to follow her orders.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: A kor commander who brings troops and prepares to retreat under Tazri's orders.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon planeswalker whose machinations freed Ulamog and called Kozilek.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: A planeswalker who in Tazri's vision dies drained by the world's fate.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: A mind mage who in Tazri's vision is killed by his own illusions.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker among those dedicated to stopping the Eldrazi who has been defeated or gone missing.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker who in Tazri's vision burns herself out against Kozilek.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose field distorts time and space, kills and warps Zendikari, and fills Tazri's visions.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan freed from its prison and loose at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The broods of the titans that harry the Zendikari.

entities.name: Roilmages
entities.description: Noyan Dar's mages who are obliterated by reflected fire and earth.

entities.name: Zendikari army
entities.description: The remnants of Gideon's army led by Tazri.

entities.name: Vampires of Guul Draz
entities.description: Drana's vampire warriors who fight in the army and raid Tazeem.

entities.name: Angel's halo
entities.description: The dull gray halo Tazri took from the angel she killed, which glows and shelters her mind during Kozilek's field.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city whose dam and walls are collapsing under the titans.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The continent whose roads Tazri guarded as a caravan captain.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: The home of the vampires who raid the coast of Tazeem.

entities.name: Coralhelm
entities.description: A floating retreat mentioned as a possible place to find a healer.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane at its final hours under two titans.

events.summary: Kozilek rises, Ulamog is freed, and Tazri rallies her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate.
events.quote: Tazri rallied her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate

events.summary: A shimmering wave from Kozilek crashes over the fleeing army, killing Romoe, Magain and Debins horribly.
The wave hits Tazri and her angel's halo glows as her past and future flicker through her mind.
Flashback: young caravan captain Tazri halts Mahir's caravan on Tazeem because something feels wrong.
Flashback: Tazri and Romoe find six dead vampires and a dying angel who begs to be killed.
Flashback: Tazri kills the angel despite warnings of a curse and takes her halo, losing something unnamed in herself.
events.quote: She reached down to take the dull gray halo from the angel's eyes.

events.summary: Flashback: years later, fired by caravan merchants and unable to dream, Tazri asks Vorik for a militia job and he hires her.
events.quote: I could use a fighter like you.

events.summary: Flashback: Vorik, dying, names Gideon Jura his successor, and Tazri feels betrayed.
events.quote: when I am gone, you will lead these people.

events.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri serves Kozilek and watches him kill Gideon, the other planeswalkers lying dead.
events.quote: Gideon Jura burst, and a bloody bag of ruptured flesh and broken bones fell limply to the ash-white earth below

events.summary: Vision of the future: Kozilek repeatedly resurrects and kills Gideon for amusement.
events.quote: Another twitch, another ripple , and Gideon Jura was reborn again

events.summary: Vision of the future: after Kozilek leaves, Tazri spends ten thousand years trying to recreate Zendikar, and then billions of years in sleep waiting for him.
events.quote: For the first ten thousand years after Kozilek's disappearance, Tazri had used her new powers to attempt the reconstruction.

events.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri tells herself the story of the day Gideon died through the dead cosmos.
events.quote: This is the story of the day Gideon died.

events.summary: The halo shields Tazri's mind, and she meets the angel she killed in a white void outside time.
events.quote: We are outside of time, Tazri.

events.summary: Tazri refuses to be healed, saying the sacrifice was hers, and the angel tells her she is forgiven and that Zendikar can win.
events.quote: You can win. You will win. There is no other option.

events.summary: Tazri returns to find her soldiers dead and Kozilek far away, and sees Noyan Dar's roilmages obliterated by reflected fire and earth.
events.quote: Tazri didn't have time to shout a warning as the fire and earth swept through the roilmages, obliterating them.

events.summary: Drana rescues Noyan Dar in mid-air, and Drana's and Munda's troops turn the tide briefly.
events.quote: The arrival of Drana's and Munda's troops had temporarily turned the tide of battle.

events.summary: Tazri assumes command, tells Noyan Dar to open a rift and orders Munda to prepare the troops to flee, leaving the dying behind.
events.quote: Munda, prepare the troops. We are getting out of here.

events.summary: Tazri persuades Drana to follow her as general and to feed energy to Noyan Dar.
Tazri decides the battle for Zendikar is just beginning.
events.quote: The battle for Zendikar was now truly beginning.

relations.note: Tazri worked for Vorik as his right hand for fifteen years.
relations.quote: She had worked for him for fifteen years.
the previous commander-general of the Zendikari army, Vorik

relations.note: Tazri takes charge of the remnants of the army.
Drana agrees to obey Tazri's commands, at least for now.
Kozilek's wave kills and warps the fleeing soldiers.
Ob Nixilis summoned Kozilek from the depths of Zendikar.
relations.quote: summoned its fellow titan Kozilek from Zendikar's depths
